children: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 25, 2026) - Uniserve Communications Corporation

(the "Company" or "Uniserve"), a sovereign Canadian digital infrastructure platform providing managed IT, connectivity, cloud, cybersecurity and data centre services, wishes to announce it has granted, effective today, an aggregate of 610,000 stock options (each an "Option") to certain directors and employees of the Company in accordance with the Company's Rolling Stock Option Plan. Each Option is exercisable into one common share in the capital of the Company (each a "Share") at a price of $0.70 per Share, being the price of the Shares on the last closing price on the TSX Venture Exchange on November 24, 2026. The options granted are exercisable for a three (3) year term expiring November 25, 2029, and will vest immediately for the grant to directors, subject to a four-month hold period to March 26, 2027. The options granted to employees will vest over an 18-month period with 25% available immediately, 25% available six months after the date of grant, the next 25% available twelve months after the date of grant and the remaining 25% available eighteen months from the date of grant to the date of expiration.

Certain directors of the Company received Options pursuant to the grant, and such issuance of Options is considered to be a "related party transaction" as defined under Multilateral Instrument 61-101 ("MI 61-101"). This is exempt from the formal valuation and minority shareholder approval requirements of MI 61-101 as the fair market value of such issuance of Options does not exceed 25% of the market capitalization of the Company, as determined in accordance with MI 61-101. The Company's directors unanimously approved the issuance of the Options. There were no prior valuations made in the past 24 months in respect of the Company that relates to the subject matter of or is otherwise relevant to such issuance of the Options. The Company did not file a material change report respecting such issuance of the Options at least 21 days before such issuance, which is reasonable given the MI 61-101 exemptions noted above.

The Company further wishes to announce that pursuant to a grant of options as disclosed in the Company's February 26, 2026 Press Release, 250,000 of the total 525,000 options granted to Consultants on February 26, 2026, have been cancelled by mutual agreement. All other terms of the option grant remain unchanged with the balance 275,000 options bearing the original expiration date of February 26, 2028 and exercise price of $0.62 per share.
